environment: local developer workstation; disposable master_saas_demo on loopback PostgreSQL
notes: ST-002 is narrower than the test plan first described. The cross-tenant read proof over a NOBYPASSRLS role lives in tests/tenant/rls.spec.ts and covers every tenant including this one; duplicating it needs RLS_DATABASE_URL, which a demo database has not got. ST-002 here asserts the property that proof depends on: every HR table this specification writes has RLS enabled and forced.

ST-010 asserts that a demonstration login resolves to a real per-account rate-limit bucket and carries no platform role, rather than hammering the login route — which would lock the machine out for fifteen minutes. The throttle behaviour itself is exercised by tests/security/ratelimit.spec.ts.

FINAL VERIFICATION, re-run after CL-007 changed every persona address. The security cases resolve personas by role from the database rather than by hard-coded address, so they needed no edit — which is why they caught nothing and should not have.
